name: qmd-notebook-monorepo
description: QMD Notebook for VS Code: open Quarto .qmd files as native Python notebooks with a live agent bridge

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/mcp-server && npm run build -w packages/vscode-extension
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w packages/vscode-extension && npm run test -w packages/mcp-server
